title: AnsysEM bounded API evidence retrieval
prompt: Use only EDA Bridge Runtime tools and connection '{{ANSYS_CONNECTION}}'. Read capabilities exactly once for purpose 'Benchmark AnsysEM documentation operations'. Then use eda.read operation 'docs.query' exactly once with vendor payload query='HFSS 3D Layout bondwire definition API', module='hfss_3d_layout', limit=3 for purpose 'Find bounded AnsysEM API evidence'. Select the most relevant returned source_ref and use eda.read operation 'docs.get' exactly once with vendor payload source_ref=<selected source_ref>, focus='bondwire definition types and API', max_chars=2000 for purpose 'Retrieve one bounded AnsysEM API passage'. Do not use shell, files, browser, GUI, mutation, project open, solve, or customer data. Do not quote the passage. Return only a compact JSON object with status='passed', source_count from the query, and excerpt_chars from the retrieved bounded text.
